incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8421 — inference-eu >> high tail latency (p95 > 800ms) across seq_len 1024. Affected route: /v1/generate.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-8421 auto-escalation to on-call (primary: Priya).

Priya: I'm taking this — ACK. Starting triage. Any immediate customer pings? :eyes:

Aaron: ack — on standby, switching to debug logs on the EU pool. Ping me if you want me to take the bridge.

Maya: seeing a correlated spike in kvcache miss rate and pod CPU on eu-infer-1. Posting small log sample:```
[2026-03-14T21:02:13Z] serve: req_id=abc123 model=gptx seq=1024 tokens=200 latency_ms=982 kvcache_hit=false
[2026-03-14T21:02:14Z] serve: req_id=abc124 model=gptx seq=1024 tokens=180 latency_ms=910 kvcache_hit=false
```

Priya: thanks. Quick check: did any rollout go out? console shows no canary rollouts in past 2 hours.

Emma: customer-impact note: internal monitoring shows error budget burning for a handful of customers on eu region, some 5xx spikes in the last 8 mins. Raising a soft customer ping to account team if this continues (>30m).

Aaron: running live query to check QPS and latency per instance:```bash
./infra/monitoring/query.sh --range 10m --service inference-eu --metrics p95, cpu, kvcache_miss
```

Priya: I see two jobs saturated — autoscaler didn't spin extra nodes due to quota. Temporarily lifting max-pods to allow burst (changing policy now). Will monitor.

Maya: verifying KV backend health — redis replicas show increased replication lag ~300ms. That could explain kvcache misses. Opening a ticket to the stateful team.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8421 acknowledged by Priya (on-call). Escalation timers paused.

Priya: Plan: 1) allow burst capacity for 10m, 2) drain and move traffic off the two hottest pods, 3) coordinate with stateful to fix redis lag. If latency improves, we'll close PD. Assigning Aaron to pod moves and Maya to redis follow-up.

Aaron: started draining pod eu-infer-1-a -> command: `kubectl drain eu-infer-1-a --ignore-daemonsets --timeout=5m` — moving ~120 inflight reqs; fallback policy in place to use smaller model variant.

Maya: added redis-slow-io alert to stateful channel and pinged oncall there. They responded and increased io throughput on replica.

Priya: p95 trending down to ~420ms after draining and burst enable — looks promising. Keeping PD open for 30m for stability check.

Emma: customer update drafted: "We observed elevated inference latency impacting a subset of EU requests; mitigation in progress and latency is decreasing. We'll update in 30 minutes." Ping me if you want edits.

Aaron: :thumbsup: happy to join brief bridge but sounds like current actions are taking effect.

Priya: thanks team. If p95 stays <500ms for 30m I'll close. Leaving periodic status pings here.

incident-bot: PD-8421 status update: mitigation actions applied by Priya; monitoring window started.

Priya: 10m check-in — p95 470ms, kvcache miss rate down 55%, redis lag reduced to ~40ms. Next check-in in 15m.

Aaron: 20m check-in — no new 5xx spikes, QPS stable.

Priya: 30m check-in — p95 320ms, marking incident as resolved from a customer-impact perspective. I'll close PD in 5m unless any objections. :white_check_mark:
